total_note: Everything priced so far, for two
intro: Your ferries, island transfers and the sunset cruise, arranged through Original Senses, my partner in Athens. A deposit locks them in; the balance is due a month before you land.

transfers.title: Athens airport to the ferry port
transfers.note: Met after the Delta arrival at 7:50am and driven to the port.

transfers.title: All four island transfers
transfers.note: Paros port to Vione, Vione to Paros port, Santorini port to Andronis Arcadia, and Andronis Arcadia to Santorini airport. Luxury vehicle with an English-speaking driver.

ferries.title: Athens to Paros, high-speed ferry
ferries.note: Morning sailing after you land; met at Paros port.

ferries.title: Paros to Santorini, Champions League Jet 1

boats.title: Private sunset caldera cruise on a Pardo 43
boats.note: Fresh fish, salads, dips, cheese and charcuterie, dessert, wine and beer, snorkel gear and a paddleboard, hotel transfers both ways.

pending_note: The Athens transfer and ferry are being priced by Original Senses now. I will add them to the deposit before you pay.

optional.title: Private full day to Antiparos, Despotiko & Panteronissia
optional.note: Axopar 28 with your own captain, towels, snorkel gear, water toys, snacks and drinks, hotel transfers both ways.
